threads.title: HW 5 problem 3: can we assume the graph is connected?
threads.document: For HW 5 problem 3, can we assume the input graph is connected, or do we need to handle multiple components?

answers.document: I think you have to handle it, the spec says arbitrary graph.
You cannot assume it is connected. Run DFS from every unvisited vertex and count components; that is part of the expected solution.
